description: This file contains C++ source code implementing HLSL translation for GLSL structures and constructors, including padding calculations and struct definitions for shader code generation.

classes.name: StructureHLSL
classes.description: Class responsible for managing HLSL structure definitions, constructors, and padding calculations for shader code translation.

classes.name: Std140PaddingHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing padding calculations in std140 layout for shader structures.

methods.name: Define
methods.description: Generates HLSL struct definition string with optional padding.

methods.name: WriteParameterList
methods.description: Creates a comma-separated list of parameter types for function signatures.

methods.name: getPaddingHelper
methods.description: Returns a padding helper instance for std140 layout.

methods.name: defineQualified
methods.description: Defines a qualified struct string with optional packing and padding.

methods.name: defineVariants
methods.description: Creates different struct variants for standard and row-major layouts.

methods.name: ensureStructDefined
methods.description: Ensures a struct is defined, generating it if necessary.

methods.name: addStructConstructor
methods.description: Adds a constructor function for a struct.

methods.name: addBuiltInConstructor
methods.description: Creates a constructor for built-in types.

methods.name: structsHeader
methods.description: Returns combined header string of all struct declarations and constructors.

methods.name: storeStd140ElementIndex
methods.description: Stores element index info for std140 layout for nested structs.
